source: stage D: SLICEM as RAM and shift register, in designs implemented by ISE (RAM16X1S / RAM16X1D / RAM32X1S / SRL16 / SRL16E / SRLC16E primitives, distributed RAMs and shift registers inferred by xst); each setting removed or the RAM made a LUT per slice position (gen-attrdrop.mjs, ana-attrdrop.mjs). The 2 USED bits of a SLICEM (F, G) are cleared by a RAM LUT, the 2 SLICEM bits (F, G) by a shift register; F:#RAM:SHIFT_REG = a LUT as shift register (F_ATTR); the write-address pins (WF1USED…), DUAL_PORT and BYINV have no bits of their own; the write strobe generator (WSGEN, in every slice with a RAM or shift register LUT) sets one bit (removing WSGEN alone does not change the bitstream: bitgen derives it)
